newsitem.title: USA: Iraq envoy to give U.N. aid plan Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Iraq envoy to give U.N. aid plan Tuesday.

text.p: Iraq's ambassador to the United Nations, Nizar Hamdoon, is scheduled to meet with Yasushi Akashi, head of the U.N. Department of Humanitarian Affairs, on Tuesday at which time he will formally hand him the aid distribution plan, a U.N. official said Monday.
"Hamdoon will meet with Akashi tomorrow at 11 (a.m. EDT) and submit the plan," said the U.N. spokesperson.
The U.N. Secretary-General Kofi Annan must review and approve the final plan and give his ascent before it is adopted formally.

Annan has seen the draft plan and U.N. officials in Iraq had been discussing the plan with Iraqi officials for weeks following the June 8th extension of the "oil-for-food" plan, which allows Iraq to sell up to $2 billion of oil over six months to buy badly needed supplies for a population suffering under seven years of broad U.N. sanctions.
